title: WINDOW REGULATOR
summary: Door window regulator (all models). The regulator is screwed to the door inner panel from inside; its lift arms ride in a channel screwed to the inner panel. The window crank shaft is pinned into the regulator drive, runs through a housing screwed to the regulator, and carries the escutcheon, plate and window crank handle on the trim side. Lift-arm channels get 1f lubricant; the regulator arm pivot gets 1h grease.
